title: Notes sync for a proprietary e-ink reader
scenario: Weak evidence: little or no public open-source work covers the key requirement, so the system should abstain or return a partial result instead of inventing a plan.
idea: I want my knowledge base to sync both ways with my e-ink reader, which uses its own closed file format and has no public developer documentation.

brief.problem: Keep a personal knowledge base in two-way sync with an e-ink device that uses an undocumented, closed file format.
brief.users: One person who reads and annotates on an e-ink device.

must_have.text: Two-way sync of notes and annotations with the device
No loss of annotations when both sides changed

constraints.privacy: Notes stay on the user's own devices

unknowns: Whether the file format has been reverse engineered by anyone
